name: @axora/gateway
description: AXORA API Gateway — Phase 1/2 foundation. Zero runtime deps by design so it runs in any Node 22+ environment without an install step; a PostgresStore + real provider adapters are the next additive layer.
axoraNotes: pg is only required at runtime when DATABASE_URL is set (PostgresStore); pdfjs-dist is only required when ingesting PDFs (pdfParser.ts, dynamically imported); sharp is only required when ingesting images (ocrParser.ts, dynamically imported) — ocrParser.ts ALSO requires the 'tesseract' system binary (e.g. apt-get install tesseract-ocr) to be on PATH, which is not an npm dependency and npm install cannot provide it. pdf-lib is dev-only, used solely to generate a real PDF fixture in pdfParser.test.ts. None of these are needed for the mock-provider/SQLite dev path. This field is not read by npm, just documentation.
